title: Line Strip
statement: Implement `solve(line)`. Remove a single trailing newline sequence if present: `\r\n`, or a final `\n`, or a final `\r`. Leave other trailing spaces in place. Do not strip the whole line.
hints: Check endswith for the two-character sequence first.
If none match, return the line unchanged.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: rstrip() would eat the trailing spaces a fixed-width field might need.

editorial: rstrip() would eat the trailing spaces a fixed-width field might need. A newline at the end of a readline result is the only thing to remove. Checking CRLF first avoids leaving a CR behind when you only strip LF.
